fields.cause_of_loss_detail: Accidental - space heater too close to bedding
fields.cause_determination: Accidental - space heater too close to bedding
fields.narrative_summary: Engine and ladder companies responded to a reported structure fire at the above address. On arrival crews found smoke showing from the bedroom. Fire was contained to the area of origin and extinguished with one handline. Occupants were evacuated prior to arrival. Scene turned over to the owner after overhaul.
